entities.name: Repeat TURBT in T1 NMIBC
observations: Guideline-based management of newly diagnosed high-grade T1 bladder cancer includes repeat TURBT of the tumor bed within about 2–6 weeks to assess residual tumor and exclude occult muscle-invasive disease before adjuvant intravesical BCG; this is especially important when detrusor muscle sampling is not specified. AUA/SUO NMIBC guideline.
